title: Smoke unit 1 throwaway doc for PR 860 campaign verification
context: PR 860 changed how the campaign runner passes its lease token and spawns its own internal reviews; a throwaway campaign exercises that path end to end.
decision: Add a one-line docs/_smoke/unit-1.md file as the minimal diff for sub-iterate 1.0; the PR stays open and is never merged.
consequences: No runtime or spec change; the branch and PR are disposable once the smoke verification is read.
rationale: The smallest possible diff isolates the runner mechanics under test from any product change.
rejected: An empty commit was rejected because the finalization gates need a real diff to measure.
